Research Experience:

1978 Honours project entitled "Inducible DNA polymerase activity in Chinese hamster cells following ionizing radiation damage". Supervisor Dr. Mike Westerman, Genetics Department, Latrobe University.

This project involved \(\gamma\) or x-ray treatment of \(G_{1}\) phase Chinese hamster DON cells and following changes in DNA polymerase activity that correlated with increased DNA repair synthesis. I found that the induced activity was totally abolished by prior treatment of cells with N-ethylmaleimide or in vitro using NEM directly in the assay mixture.

We conclude that the inducible DNA polymerase activity may correspond to that of DNA polymerase alpha or possible gamma. This was an unexpected although interesting finding as DNA polymerase Beta seems to be involved in DNA repair of UV induced damage.
